name: University of Galway
description: University of Galway is a public research university in Galway, founded in 1845 as Queen's College Galway. It has over 19,000 students.
whyIncluded: Its MB BCh BAO is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and the university's Singapore page profiles Singaporean students in its medical programme.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own monthly budget for international students (rent, bills, food, books, personal costs) for 9 months. It has no transport line and its rent figure is well below current Galway rents.
livingCosts.notes: University of Galway Global 'Average Monthly Cost of Living' table for international students: accommodation EUR 400 + utilities EUR 80 = housing; food EUR 260; personal = books and study materials EUR 60 + clothes/laundry EUR 60 + recreation EUR 180 + other EUR 160; total EUR 1,200 a month. The table has no transport line, so transport is 0. The page is undated (read 2026-09-30) and its accommodation figure is far below current Galway rents; the university's accommodation service says a single room in a shared house is c. EUR 700-1,200 a month. The university's separate cost-of-living page lists only item prices, not a budget.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Science and Information Technology (GY350)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international (non-EU) students, including the EUR 140 student levy. Fees for later years rise by about 5% a year, so the total will be higher.
programmes.notes: University of Galway undergraduate fee table, 'International (non-EU) fee' column, 2026/27, per annum; 4-year degree. The figure includes the EUR 140 student levy payable by all students (Galway quotes fees levy-inclusive, e.g. the EU total EUR 7,408 = tuition EUR 4,768 + contribution EUR 2,500 + levy EUR 140), so no separate compulsory fee is added. Fee regulations: for 2026/27 entrants on courses longer than a year an inflationary increase of 5% a year applies to continuing years, so the fee is not fixed. 2024/25 row: Wayback Machine capture of 3 Sep 2024 of the official undergraduate fee table ('Fees 2024/25 AY'), 'International (non-EU) fee' column: GY350 'EUR 26,000 p.a. (EUR 26,140 p.a. including levy) 2024/25'; the levy-inclusive figure is recorded, matching the current row's convention (student levy EUR 140 p.a. 2024/25 in the same row). 2025/26 row: Wayback Machine capture of 5 Aug 2025 of the same table, GY350 'EUR 27,140 p.a. 2025/2026 (EU total stated 'including levy')' (student levy EUR 140 p.a. 2025/26 in the same row); levy-inclusive figure recorded.
